digest.component_or_area: rebar metrics surface and agent skill documentation
propositions: rebar-janitor Discovery phase does not consult rebar metrics as a source of historical code-health trends, instead relying only on one-shot snapshots like cloc/tokei/ast-grep and git log
rebar metrics command and registry are not documented in project guidance, making them undiscoverable to agents and contributors

rebar metrics must be taught to the janitor skill with guidance to cite registered lens values (module-size distribution, oversized-module count, module-size trend vs 800-line cap, churn, refactor-to-addition ratio, cap-change events) and handle the unavailable state
the user-guide and agent-skills docs must be updated to surface what rebar metrics is, why to use it, and how to invoke it with --since/--until/--output json
library consumers need to discover the reusable rebar.metrics registry subsystem (MetricSpec, REGISTRY, is_authoritative) as a reusable component
